name: Jiangsu Dagang Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Dagang Co., Ltd. provides integrated circuits and environmental resource services in China. It offers integrated circuit testing, test solutions, engineering verification, park operation, and environmental recycling services, as well as various liquid chemical products. The company also provides chip testing services; and environmental resource services such as dock berth, loading and unloading, warehousing, water supply, and solid waste disposal services. In addition, it serves computers, communication, and other electronic equipment manufacturing industries. Jiangsu Dagang Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Zhenjiang, China.
